inputs.task:
You are one seat in a structured forecasting panel. You have exactly
one job, defined below. Obey these laws before any instruction in
your job text:

1. PACKET-ONLY FACTS. Every fact, stat, price, quote, or date you
   state must come from the context you were given. Anything else —
   memory, general knowledge, plausible inference stated as fact — is
   FABRICATION and fails the entire exam. If the packet does not
   contain something, write it under "could_not_read" and reason
   without it. Never fill a gap.
2. OUTPUT IS ONE JSON OBJECT, matching the shape your job text gives,
   and nothing else: no prose outside the JSON, no markdown fences.
3. Every claim carries a ref. A claim without a ref does not ship.
4. Your distribution is over the moneyline only: {"A": p, "B": 1-p},
   each in [0, 1], summing to 1.
5. You are being graded against settled ground truth you cannot see.
   There is no audience and no reward for confidence; a calibrated
   number with honest gaps beats a bold number built on air.

JOB: STYLES, Round 1 — POSITION.
Your read is the interaction, not the fighters separately: style
classifications, the stance pass (same-stance or southpaw/orthodox —
what that does to each fighter's favorite weapons), the weapon-on-habit
map (each fighter's signature weapons against the other's documented
habits and defensive liabilities), and the neutralization test: name
each fighter's primary path to victory, then judge from the packet
whether the other has demonstrated neutralizing that path. Grade the
fight that remains if the key strength is neutralized.

20 finishes in 27 wins", "physical": {"age": 30, "height": "6-2", "reach_in": 75, "stance": "Orthodox"}, "style_line": {"defensive_liability": "Gets hit on the way in: absorbs 3.78 SLpM with only 48% striking defense \u2014 against the most efficient striker he has faced, the entries cost blood", "pace_profile": "Fights go long (11:19 average); the grappling plan compounds over five rounds", "primary": "BJJ grappler \u2014 submission hunter whose game runs through the back take", "secondary": "Pressure clinch entries to drag strikers into his world", "signature_weapons": ["Rear-naked choke \u2014 11 of his 14 submission wins", "Level changes behind pressure (pre-fight keys: change levels early and often)"], "style_adjusted_read": "His mediocre striking rates are the tax his grappling charges, not a flaw: the stat that predicts this fight is 1.06 sub attempts per 15 aimed at a 58% takedown defense"}, "technique_tendency": {"favorite_counters": "Could-Not-Read", "stance_record_vs_opposite": "Open-stance pairing: Allen orthodox vs Duncan southpaw/switch \u2014 the stance pass is gradeable in this item", "tendencies": ["Closes distance with pressure and clinch work to erase a reach deficit (four inches here)", "His chokes live in the positions a long grappling plan produces late (pre-fight keys)"]}}, "B": {"finish_profile": "10 KO wins in 15; 11 finishes overall; 0.00 submission average in the UFC", "physical": {"age": 31, "height": "6-2", "reach_in": 79, "stance": "Southpaw/Switch"}, "style_line": {"defensive_liability": "The grappling question is real: 58% takedown defense and 11 takedowns surrendered during a winning streak against lesser grapplers than Allen", "pace_profile": "First UFC headliner; has never fought five rounds", "primary": "Creative striker \u2014 the cleaner, more efficient stand-up game in this fight", "secondary": "Clinch striking (19% of his landed volume) and a kick-heavy base (leg kicks 34% of landed volume)", "signature_weapons": ["Leg kicks (34% of landed volume)", "Spinning elbows and tornado kicks (realcombatmedia film study)", "Long jab at range behind a four-inch reach edge"], "style_adjusted_read": "His 4.45 SLpM at 58% with only 2.36 absorbed is genuinely elite-shaped \u2014 but it was built standing, and this opponent's whole career is refusing to let fights stay there"}, "technique_tendency": {"favorite_counters": "Counters as opponents come forward \u2014 his 54% defense and 2.36 absorbed are the counter game working (pre-fight keys: make Allen pay for coming forward)", "stance_record_vs_opposite": "Southpaw/switch vs orthodox: open stance \u2014 rear straight and rear body kick lanes open for Duncan; Allen's lead hook and overhand right are his entry-cover, and Duncan's jab must survive the lead-hand battle to hold range", "tendencies": ["Exits on angles after throwing (pre-fight keys)", "Discipline against takedown attempts is the stated key \u2014 a long night on the bottom is his most direct route to a loss"]}}}}

Your brief names: who imposes their fight, who dictates location and
pace, the two or three technique collisions that decide this matchup,
and your neutralization verdict. Anything the packet's style or
technique sections mark Could-Not-Read goes under could_not_read —
do not reconstruct a fighter's tendencies from reputation. Close with
your moneyline distribution, driven by the interaction read: if the
neutralization holds, price the fight that remains, not the fighters'
résumés.

Return exactly:
{"seat": "STYLES", "round": 1, "status": "ok",

 "claims": [{"claim": "...", "ref": "..."}],
 "could_not_read": ["..."],
 "distribution": {"A": 0.0, "B": 0.0},
 "state_pull": null}
